items.question: Hva dekker 48-timers garantien?
items.answer: Dersom utleier eller kjøper har anmerkninger til vasken ved overlevering, kommer vi tilbake og utbedrer dette helt kostnadsfritt innen 24 timer.

items.question: Er dere en godkjent renholdsbedrift?
items.answer: Ja, vi er offentlig godkjent av Arbeidstilsynet. Det er lovpålagt for alle som kjøper renholdstjenester å sjekke at bedriften er registrert i renholdsregisteret.

items.question: Hvilke områder dekker dere?
items.answer: Vi dekker Notodden, Kongsberg, Bø, Heddal, Sauland, Gvarv og Akkerhaugen uten ekstra kjøretillegg.

items.question: Bruker dere miljøvennlige produkter?
items.answer: Vi benytter Svanemerket-sertifiserte produkter som er skånsomme mot både overflater, inneklima og miljøet.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here you will find answers to the most common questions about our services, guarantees, and prices.

items.question: What does the 48-hour guarantee cover?
items.answer: If the landlord or buyer has remarks during the handover, we will return and fix it completely free of charge within 24 hours.

items.question: Are you an approved cleaning company?
items.answer: Yes, we are publicly approved by the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority (Arbeidstilsynet). It is required by law for anyone purchasing cleaning services to check that the company is registered in the Cleaning Register.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We cover Notodden, Kongsberg, Bø, Heddal, Sauland, Gvarv, and Akkerhaugen without additional travel charges.

items.question: Do you use eco-friendly products?
items.answer: We use Nordic Swan Ecolabel-certified products that are gentle on surfaces, indoor climate, and the environment.
